### Changed
- **The serving slice on KServe v0.21.0, and a served model rolls without a surge pod** (giantswarm/agent-platform#682). `components.kserve-llmisvc-crd`, `components.kserve-llmisvc-resources` and `components.kserve-runtime-configs` move to `0.7.x` (giantswarm/kserve#101, #102). The `kserve-runtime-configs:` block passes `kserve.llmisvcConfigs.rolloutStrategy: {maxSurge: 0, maxUnavailable: 1}`. The controller merges it from the single-node presets into every `LLMInferenceService`, so a predictor's roll stops the old pod before it starts the new one. A model that fills its GPU could never start the surge pod, and its roll never finished. The runtime stays `llm-d-cuda:v0.8.0` (vLLM 0.23.0): the block pins the `main` image of the six GPU presets (`kserve.llmisvcConfigs.images`), since the 0.7.x presets name llm-d v0.9.0, whose vLLM 0.26.0 cannot load Gemma 4 (`gemma-4-31b` crash-loops on `head_dim is a per-layer attribute`). The presets' v0.10.0 routers come with the charts. `make verify-serving-slice` holds the pinned image equal to the pre-pulled one.
